offering_description.value: Badger Meter sells water meters, remote monitoring equipment and cloud software to public and private water and wastewater utilities. It also supplies flow instruments to industrial facilities and equipment manufacturers. It manufactures meters and sensors and uses connected devices to send readings to its cloud platform.

primary_products.value: Water meters; remote meter-reading equipment; water and sewer network sensors; water quality instruments; industrial flow meters

primary_services.value: Cloud-based meter data management; remote water and sewer network monitoring and analytics

customer_segment.value: B2G: Municipal water utilities and public wastewater agencies; B2B: Privately owned utilities, industrial plants, commercial building operators and equipment manufacturers

end_markets.value: Drinking water utilities; wastewater collection; industrial process control; commercial building water management

revenue_model.value: product sales: Water meters, communications equipment, monitoring sensors and industrial flow instruments; subscription: Cloud access for meter data, remote monitoring and network analytics

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds meters and monitoring instruments from mechanical and electronic components for utilities and industrial customers; software / platform: Turns meter and sensor readings into dashboards and alerts for utility operators

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: Utility water metering, water and sewer network monitoring, water quality measurement and industrial flow instrumentation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Company sales teams serving utilities and industrial accounts; distributors / dealers: Waterworks distributors and industrial instrumentation distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Drinking-water-contact components face NSF/ANSI standards and wireless equipment faces FCC requirements
